audience: support teams that answer website chats in Userlike

useCases.title: Check open conversations for the team
useCases.text: List the conversations, filtered by operator, status or update time. Then read the messages of one conversation, page by page.

useCases.title: Review a contact before a reply
useCases.text: Get one contact, then list the notes on that contact for the earlier context.

useCases.title: Check operator capacity before routing chats
useCases.text: List the operators, then read the chat slot use of one operator to see its used, total and available slots.

useCases.title: Add an internal note to a chat or contact
useCases.text: Add an internal note to one conversation or one contact. Operators see the note, but the contact does not.

useCases.title: Set an operator away or back online
useCases.text: Set one operator to away, or back online. An away operator receives no new chats.
